title: Provider notice
description: One notice from a cloud provider, normalized: scheduled maintenance, a retirement, an advisory, a security advisory, an upcoming change or an incident. Neutral: it holds what the provider published about the tenant, account, tenancy or project, never an agency's routing or names. Times are UTC, ISO 8601 with a Z.

cloud.description: The provider's cloud or partition the notice was read from, such as AzureUSGovernment, gcc, oc2 or aws-us-gov

sourceId.description: The provider's own identifier: tracking ID, MC or issue ID, announcement OCID, event ARN or event name

summary.description: Plain text, at most 2,000 characters; markup removed

resources.description: Resource IDs, ARNs or OCIDs the provider names as affected

actionBasis.description: Why actionRequired is what it is: 'provider: <field and value>' when the provider says so, 'rule: <kit rule>' when the kit infers it, or 'none'

providerSeverity.description: The provider's own severity, level or type, unchanged

sourceUrl.description: The provider's API URL for the notice, where its documentation gives one

sourceRef.description: What a person searches for in the provider's console

firstSeen.description: When this kit first read the notice (the router keeps it across runs)

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the record without firstSeen and fingerprint; a change means the provider updated the notice
